description: Ground truth from Holosoma's G1 29-DoF velocity-tracking env (amazon-far/holosoma 79ba714, unmodified) for checking XSoma's task term by term; produced by xsoma/tools/holosoma_dump.py
command: python tools/holosoma_dump.py --out out/g1_ppo_plane --policy ppo_model_00700.npz -- exp:g1-29dof simulator:mujoco terrain:terrain-locomotion-plane logger:disabled --logger.base-dir=out/hs --training.num-envs=1 --training.seed=42

action_schedule.rule: policy phases: the policy's mean action on the actor observation (with Holosoma's noise) + N(0, policy_noise^2); noise phases: N(0, sigma^2); i.i.d. per joint from numpy RandomState(action_seed)

conventions.quaternions: MuJoCo arrays (pre/sub/post_qpos) wxyz; Holosoma arrays (root_state, body_quat) xyzw
conventions.angular_velocity: qvel[3:6] pelvis body frame (MuJoCo); Holosoma root_state[10:13] and body_ang_vel world frame
conventions.linear_velocity: world frame, of the pelvis frame origin (MuJoCo free joint), also in Holosoma's root_state
conventions.order: joints in dof_names (Holosoma config) order; bodies in body_names order; t indexes policy steps after reset_all
conventions.dtypes: Holosoma tensors float32 (as in Holosoma), MuJoCo arrays float64

array_docs.pre_qpos: MuJoCo qpos the physics starts from (read at the first substep, after Holosoma flushed pending writes): free joint (x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz; world), then the 29 joints in dof_names order
array_docs.pre_qvel: MuJoCo qvel likewise: free joint (vx, vy, vz world-frame velocity of the pelvis frame origin; wx, wy, wz in the pelvis BODY frame, MuJoCo's convention), then joint velocities
array_docs.pre_root_state: Holosoma's robot_root_states before the step (float32): pos, quat xyzw, linear velocity world, angular velocity WORLD frame (Holosoma rotates MuJoCo's body-frame free-joint angular velocity to world on read)
array_docs.pre_command: [vx, vy, wz] body-frame command the policy saw (command_manager.commands)
array_docs.pre_phase: gait phase (left, right) the policy saw; gait_freq Hz, phase_dt = 2 pi dt f, phase_offset (left, right)
array_docs.pre_episode_length: episode_length_buf before the step (0 right after a reset)
array_docs.pre_action_delay_idx: action delay in policy steps (0 or 1); pre_action_queue[0] newest clipped action, [1] previous
array_docs.pre_kp_scale / pre_kd_scale: PD gain scales of the episode (multiply p_gains / d_gains)
array_docs.pre_last_action: action_manager.action before the step = previous raw action (zero after a reset)
array_docs.pre_penalty_scale: penalty curriculum scale (multiplies the penalty_curriculum-tagged weights at the step's reward)
array_docs.pre_avg_episode_length: average episode length of the curriculum tracker
array_docs.pre_push_counter / pre_push_interval_s /: push schedule: a push fires in the step whose incremented counter equals int(interval_s / dt)
array_docs.action: raw action a_t given to env.step (float32)
array_docs.action_kind / policy_mean: schedule phase of the step (0 policy, 1 noise, 2 zero) and the policy's mean action (zero outside policy phases); the policy reads actor_obs of the previous step (init_actor_obs at t = 0)
array_docs.action_applied: after clip(+-100) and the delay queue: the PD law's action input during the step
array_docs.sub_qpos / sub_qvel: (T, 4, .) MuJoCo state entering each of the 4 substeps (same layout as pre_qpos / pre_qvel)
array_docs.sub_ctrl: (T, 4, 29) data.ctrl at each mj_step (dof order): Holosoma's PD torque clipped to torque_limits; MuJoCo then clamps it to mj_actuator_ctrlrange (hip roll 88 N m)
array_docs.sub_torque: Holosoma's own torques_substep (float32 copy of the same torques)
array_docs.post_qpos / post_qvel: MuJoCo state after the 4 substeps, before resets (rewards and terminations are computed on it)
array_docs.post_root_state / post_dof_pos / post_do: Holosoma's served copies of it (float32; angular velocity world frame)
array_docs.post_body_pos / post_body_quat / post_bo: (T, nbody, .) Holosoma's _rigid_body_* in body_names order: world positions of the body frames, quaternions xyzw, world linear velocity of the body frame origin, world angular velocity (MuJoCo mj_objectVelocity, world orientation)
array_docs.post_contact_forces: (T, nbody, 3) world-frame net contact force per body after the last substep (Holosoma's contact_forces; the contact termination reads termination_contact_indices of it)
array_docs.post_feet_heights: terrain manager feet_heights (left, right): z of feet_height_indices bodies (foot contact points) minus the ray-cast terrain height; post_feet_ray_hits the hit points
array_docs.post_command / post_phase: command and phase at reward time (= pre_*: the ones the policy saw)
array_docs.post_action / post_prev_action: action manager's action and prev_action at reward time (a_t, a_{t-1})
array_docs.reward_raw: (T, 10) unweighted reward terms in reward_terms order (Holosoma's term functions' outputs)
array_docs.reward_weight: (T, 10) the weights used (config weight x penalty scale for tagged terms), without dt
array_docs.reward: Holosoma's total reward rew_buf = sum_i reward_weight_i * dt * reward_raw_i
array_docs.term_contact / term_timeout: termination terms (contact force > 1 N on a termination body; episode_length > 1000)
array_docs.reset / time_out: reset_buf (contact or timeout) and time_out_buf of the step
array_docs.actor_obs / critic_obs: observations returned by env.step (after resets, command update, pushes)
array_docs.actor_noise: noise added to the actor observation in raw units before scaling: actor_obs = clip((raw + noise) * scale, +-100); critic_obs is noise free
array_docs.next_*: task state after the step (same meaning as pre_*; next_*[t] = pre_*[t+1] except pre_qpos / pre_qvel, which are MuJoCo's state after Holosoma's pending writes are flushed; next_root_state already holds a push's velocity)
array_docs.next_gait_command / next_gait_phase_dt: the command the gait step's stand rule read and the phase_dt it used (after this step's resets, before its command resampling: on a reset step the reset's draw, which the second draw in command_manager.step replaces; on a resampling step the old frequency, so next_phase = phase(next_episode_length, next_gait_phase_dt, next_phase_offset, next_gait_command) while next_phase_dt is already the new one)
array_docs.final_actor_obs / final_critic_obs: Holosoma's terminal observations of the pre-reset state on time-out steps (extras['final_observations'], used for bootstrapping); zeros on other steps
array_docs.pushed / push_vel: a push fired at the end of this step and the world xy root velocity it set
array_docs.init_actor_obs / init_critic_obs: observations returned by reset_all (the policy's input for step 0)
array_docs.mj_*: compiled MuJoCo model after Holosoma's start-up randomization (robot bodies in body_names order; all geoms; pairs)
